messages:
sam: FYI AP posted a credit memo from Zenith Labs (INV-CM-2042) without a PO match; system routed it to ENG-OPS by mistake. PDF uploaded to Concur: https://concur.company/receipts/INV-CM-2042 @devin @lisa can you take a look?

devin: on it. do we have a vendor-supplied PO number in their email or PDF? I'll pull the match logs.

ProcureBot: Coupa match attempt: no exact PO match found for INV-CM-2042. Nearest candidates: PO#87654 (status: closed 2025-11-02), PO#88765 (status: open). Suggested match: PO#88765 (vendor-specified) - requires manual confirmation.

marta: AP view: credit posted to AP Clearing with a GL split. Approver was ENG-OPS (wrong). Sam, please hold final posting until we confirm PO.

sam: Holding posting. Current AP post snapshot: 

```csv
invoice,line,amount,gl_code,percent
INV-CM-2042,1,7000,6110-EngOps,70%
INV-CM-2042,2,3000,8005-CloudCosts,30%
```

lisa: I called Zenith. They confirmed the credit should apply to PO#88765 and admitted a digit was transposed on their original PDF. They're resending a corrected credit memo with PO#88765 called out. I can vouch for the rematch.

alex: if 88765 is valid we should rematch and ensure the approver routes to Vendor Relations (@lisa). Also proposing an automation to flag credits referencing closed POs. I'll sketch an RFC.

devin: created ticket FIN-900 to track rematch and routing fix. ProcureBot, can you attempt re-association and tag FIN-900?

ProcureBot: Re-association queued. PO#88765 matched and vendor verified (supplier id: ZEN-001). Ticket FIN-900 created. Status: pending AP finalize.

sam: added note to invoice: "Hold - pending PO rematch FIN-900". Will reapply once ProcureBot confirms.

ProcureBot: FIN-900 update: rematch completed at 1770012600, awaiting AP apply.

sam: applied credit at 1770012699. Moved from AP Clearing -> applied to PO#88765. GL split unchanged. Closing ticket FIN-900.

marta: resolved, thanks everyone. alex please follow up on the closed-PO credit detection RFC.

alex: will draft RFC and post to #eng-finance next week. :thumbsup:
